from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs/task-13c27ac0.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(3 * m)] for _ in range(3 * n)]
    for block_r in range(3):
        for block_c in range(3):
            for r in range(n):
                for c in range(m):
                    src_r = n - 1 - r if block_r != 1 else r
                    src_c = m - 1 - c if block_c != 1 else c
                    out[block_r * n + r][block_c * m + c] = grid[src_r][src_c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
